reported_issue: Bolls dropping prematurely, and green bolls have small dark pinholes with lint inside turning brownish-pink.
field_officer_diagnosis: Pink Bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella) internal locule damage. Green boll destructive sampling showed 14% damaged bolls with 3rd instar pink larvae feeding inside seeds.
certified_remediation_plan: Install 8 Pectino-lure pheromone traps per acre immediately to monitor and mass-trap male moths.
Manual collection and burning of rosette flowers and shed bolls.
Foliar spray of CIBRC registered Proclaim 5% SG (Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG) @ 88 g/acre (6.6 g per 15L backpack pump in 200 L water/acre).
Maintain statutory pre-harvest interval of 14 days before cotton picking.
Terminate standing crop by end of December; avoid ratooning.

reported_issue: Circular patches of crop turning dry and yellow; base of rice hills completely covered with thousands of small brown insects.
field_officer_diagnosis: Brown Plant Hopper (Nilaparvata lugens) hopper burn outbreak at critical booting stage. Hopper count averaged 45 insects per hill (severe economic damage threshold).
certified_remediation_plan: Immediately drain standing canal water from field for 4 consecutive days.
Create walking alleys (skipping/parting 1 row after every 8 rows) to admit sunlight and ventilation to the plant bases.
Apply Chess 50% WG (Pymetrozine 50% WG) @ 120 g/acre (9 g per 15L knapsack pump) with flat-fan nozzle directed strictly onto stem bases.
Strictly avoid synthetic pyrethroid sprays to prevent secondary resurgence.

farmer_location: Tadikonda Mandal, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh
reported_issue: Top tender leaves curling upwards like boat hulls, leaf margins bronzed and brittle, flower bud abortion.
field_officer_diagnosis: Severe Chilli Thrips (Scirtothrips dorsalis) infestation. Lacerations visible on undersides of apical leaves. Average count 6 thrips per leaf.
certified_remediation_plan: Erect 20 blue sticky traps per acre at crop canopy height.
Foliar spray of Pegasus 50% WP (Diafenthiuron 50% WP) @ 240 g/acre (18 g per 15L backpack pump in 200 L water/acre).
Maintain 7-day pre-harvest interval.
Follow up with Neem oil 1500 ppm @ 2 ml/L after 10 days.

reported_issue: Central leaves drying from tip down, pseudostem base soft and rotten, emits foul smell, rhizomes rotting in waterlogged patches.
field_officer_diagnosis: Rhizome Rot / Soft Rot (Pythium aphanidermatum) compounded by severe surface drainage congestion during heavy August downpour.
certified_remediation_plan: Open deep drainage channels at 5-meter intervals to evacuate stagnant water immediately.
Remove and destroy severely rotted clumps outside field.
Drench pseudostem collars with Ridomil Gold (Metalaxyl 4% + Mancozeb 64% WP) @ 2.5 g/L (37.5 g per 15L pump) using 300 ml solution per clump.
Incorporate neem cake @ 150 kg/acre along with Trichoderma viride around remaining healthy beds.

farmer_location: Sanwer Tehsil, Indore District, Madhya Pradesh
reported_issue: Leaves showing extensive windowpanes, larvae cutting leaf edges and looping, heavy defoliation.
field_officer_diagnosis: Semilooper (Chrysodeixis acuta) outbreak. Caterpillar count: 6 larvae per meter row length (above economic threshold level of 3-4 larvae/meter).
certified_remediation_plan: Foliar spray of Fame 39.35% SC (Flubendiamide 39.35% SC) @ 60 ml/acre (4.5 ml per 15L backpack pump).
Observe 30-day statutory PHI.
Erect 15 T-shaped bird perches per acre.

reported_issue: Linear bright yellow powdery stripes appearing on flag leaves across 2 acres.
field_officer_diagnosis: Yellow / Stripe Rust (Puccinia striiformis f. sp. tritici) initial foci under cool foggy conditions.
certified_remediation_plan: Immediately spray Tilt 25% EC (Propiconazole 25% EC) @ 200 ml/acre (15 ml per 15L backpack pump) in 200 L water/acre.
Ensure 30-day PHI.
Survey adjacent wheat fields for community containment.

reported_issue: Round holes in developing fruits with caterpillar head feeding inside; circular concentric ring spots on lower leaves.
field_officer_diagnosis: Tomato Fruit Borer (Helicoverpa armigera) combined with Early Blight (Alternaria solani).
certified_remediation_plan: Coragen 18.5% SC (Chlorantraniliprole) @ 60 ml/acre (4.5 ml per 15L pump) for Fruit Borer (PHI 3 days).
Dithane M-45 (Mancozeb 75% WP) @ 600 g/acre (45 g per 15L pump) for Early Blight (PHI 5 days).
Apply in separate sequential sprays or verify statutory label approvals.

farmer_location: Nandyal Mandal, Nandyal District, Andhra Pradesh
reported_issue: Larvae chewing green chickpea pods, boreholes with caterpillar head thrust inside.
field_officer_diagnosis: Gram Pod Borer (Helicoverpa armigera). Larval population: 2 larvae per meter row.
certified_remediation_plan: Foliar spray of Proclaim 5% SG (Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG) @ 88 g/acre (6.6 g per 15L backpack pump).
Observe 14-day pre-harvest interval.
Install 4 Helilure pheromone traps per acre.

reported_issue: Inflorescence and pods encrusted with green aphids, honeydew mold coating upper twigs.
field_officer_diagnosis: Mustard Aphid (Lipaphis erysimi) heavy infestation (>35% plants infested).
certified_remediation_plan: Spray Rogor 30% EC (Dimethoate 30% EC) @ 264 ml/acre (20 ml per 15L backpack pump) in late afternoon.
Ensure 15-day PHI.
Avoid spraying while honeybees are actively pollinating.

reported_issue: Snake-skin shaped greenish-grey lesions with dark brown borders on lower leaf sheaths at waterline.
field_officer_diagnosis: Sheath Blight (Rhizoctonia solani). Lesions ascending from water line to 3rd leaf sheath.
certified_remediation_plan: Drain field water slightly to expose lower stems to air.
Spray Contaf 5% SC (Hexaconazole 5% SC) @ 400 ml/acre (30 ml per 15L backpack pump) directed at stem bases.
Observe 30-day PHI.

reported_issue: Dead hearts in young shoots, central spindle dried and pulling out with rotting odor.
field_officer_diagnosis: Early Shoot Borer (Chilo infuscatellus). Dead heart percentage: 18% (above 15% threshold).
certified_remediation_plan: Soil directed drench of Coragen 18.5% SC (Chlorantraniliprole) @ 150 ml/acre along cane rows followed by light irrigation.
Trash mulching in alternate furrows.
Observe 45-day PHI.

farmer_location: Sadar Tehsil, Agra District, Uttar Pradesh
reported_issue: Dark water-soaked necrotic blighting on leaf tips; white delicate downy mold on underside in early morning.
field_officer_diagnosis: Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans) triggered by 3 days of dense fog and low temperatures (14°C).
certified_remediation_plan: Foliar spray of Ridomil Gold (Metalaxyl-M 4% + Mancozeb 64% WP) @ 500 g/acre (37.5 g per 15L backpack pump).
Observe 14-day PHI.
High earthing up to protect tubers.

farmer_location: Yellandu Mandal, Bhadradri Kothagudem District, Telangana
reported_issue: Shot holes and large irregular papery windowpanes on leaves with larvae inside whorl.
field_officer_diagnosis: Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda) early whorl damage (12% infested plants).
certified_remediation_plan: Directed spray of Delegate 11.7% SC (Spinetoram 11.7% SC) @ 180 ml/acre (13.5 ml per 15L pump) into whorl funnel.
Observe 14-day PHI.
Erect T-shaped bird perches.

farmer_location: Dhone Mandal, Nandyal District, Andhra Pradesh
reported_issue: Purple-centered elliptical spots with yellow halos on leaves, leaves drying from tip down.
field_officer_diagnosis: Purple Blotch (Alternaria porri) exacerbated by thrips lacerations.
certified_remediation_plan: Spray Custodia (Azoxystrobin + Tebuconazole) @ 300 ml/acre (22.5 ml per 15L pump) + Pegasus 50% WP @ 240 g/acre with sticker.
Observe 5-day PHI.
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation.

reported_issue: Severe upward leaf curling, extreme puckering, stunted bush appearance with no flower set.
field_officer_diagnosis: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV) transmitted by Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci).
certified_remediation_plan: Rogue out and bury severely infected stunted plants immediately.
Spray Token 20% SG (Dinotefuran 20% SG) @ 80 g/acre or Actara 25% WG @ 40 g/acre to control whitefly vector.
Install yellow sticky traps @ 20 traps/acre.

farmer_location: Dharampuri Tehsil, Dhar District, Madhya Pradesh
reported_issue: Leaf edges curling downward, turning yellow then reddish-brown, sideways walking nymphs on leaf undersides.
field_officer_diagnosis: Cotton Jassids / Leafhopper (Amrasca biguttula biguttula) hopper burn.
certified_remediation_plan: Foliar spray of Ulala 50% WG (Flonicamid 50% WG) @ 80 g/acre (6.0 g per 15L backpack pump).
Observe 20-day PHI.
Install yellow sticky traps.

reported_issue: Central shoots turning straw-colored and drying (dead hearts), easily detached upon slight pull.
field_officer_diagnosis: Yellow Stem Borer (Scirpophaga incertulas). Dead heart incidence: 7% (above 5% ETL).
certified_remediation_plan: Foliar spray of Caldan 50% SP (Cartap Hydrochloride 50% SP) @ 400 g/acre (30 g per 15L pump).
Observe 21-day PHI.
Clip seedling tips in future nurseries.

reported_issue: Water-soaked translucent streaks on leaf margins turning wavy yellowish-white with bacterial ooze beads.
field_officer_diagnosis: Bacterial Leaf Blight (Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae).
certified_remediation_plan: Drain standing water and stop top-dressing urea immediately.
Spray Streptocycline @ 24 g/acre + Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 500 g/acre in 200 L water.
Observe 15-day PHI.

reported_issue: Leaves showing bright yellow mosaic patches interspersed with dark green blistered areas; flowers dropping.
field_officer_diagnosis: Mungbean Yellow Mosaic Virus (MYMV) vectored by Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci).
certified_remediation_plan: Rogue out initial infected yellow plants.
Spray Actara 25% WG (Thiamethoxam 25% WG) @ 40 g/acre (3 g per 15L pump) to knock down whitefly vector.
Install yellow sticky traps @ 20/acre.

reported_issue: White blister-like pustules on lower leaves; floral heads swollen and distorted into stagheads.
field_officer_diagnosis: White Rust (Albugo candida) systemic staghead infection.
certified_remediation_plan: Clip and destroy staghead malformations.
Foliar spray of Ridomil Gold (Metalaxyl 4% + Mancozeb 64% WP) @ 500 g/acre (37.5 g per 15L pump).
Observe 14-day PHI.
